pro_course_detail.title: Public Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you presenting a report in front of your fellow classmates? Do you have a team project that must be presented to your bosses and colleagues? Are you giving a speech in front of a group of strangers? Are you nervous? Don't be! I can help. 

I have personally been taking public speaking courses for over 15 years and I would love to share some tips of the trade with you. I have experience with speaking in front of small groups of a few dozen, to even up to a few thousand people. It may be daunting, but it can be done, and even done in a way that captivates your audience!

The course includes: 

1. Reviewing your speech, checking for places where your English can match what you are presenting. Overly formal and overly casual can negatively affect your speech. 

2. Correcting any grammar or pronunciation problems.

3. Fine tuning your presentation skills. This would include points such as, Interest Arousing Introduction, Modulation, Fluent Delivery, Appropriate Pausing, Gestures and Facial Expressions, Naturalness, Poise, Use of a Microphone, Conversational Manner, Use of an Outline and many more. 

Let me help you turn your weaknesses into your strengths. The skills you learn in this class will not only help you with next weeks presentation but also give you the confidence to take up any assignment your boss hands to you, even if it's last minute! 

I look forward to working with you!

I know how nerve-wracking it can be as a language learner, no matter what level you are, and so I want you to feel happy and comfortable during our lessons to make mistakes and not feel embarrassed. Making mistakes with me is the best thing you can do as I'll correct you (nicely, of course!) and help you stop making that mistake again. All of this will be done naturally as I don't want anyone to feel overwhelmed by English, particularly when speaking with me.

Due to my style of teaching and personal preference, I do not teach children.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is relaxed but focused. I want you to feel comfortable talking to be, and I don't want you to dread lessons. I provide homework if you want it, but never feel stressed if you don't have time to do it. It's not the end of the world, and we'll have a productive lesson regardless.

Lessons with me are, I hope, like chatting with a friend who corrects you. They're based around one specific topic for each lesson. We can be talking about plastic in the environment one day, and the Game of Thrones episode the next. I will let you know the topic in advance so that you can prepare in advance. If you want it, I'll also provide preparation material.

pro_course_detail.title: American English Pronunciation/ Accent Reduction- INTENSIVE
pro_course_detail.description:
I specialize in American English Pronunciation/ Accent Reduction for intermediate and advanced-level grammar students. My classes are very structured and start with a PDF and audio file that I will send you before class begins. Each class will be based on the aforementioned PDF and audio files. My classes are very focused so be prepared to jump into the fundamentals of American English Pronunciation. In my class, you will learn proven techniques to reduce your accent. We will start with the vowels- monophthongs and diphthongs, and the I.P.A- International Phonetic Alphabet. I will break it down into easy and understandable language. We will study mouth, tongue, and lip positioning, as well as other techniques in order to achieve those often difficult vowel sounds. We will then move on to reductions, syllable stress, intonation, word linking, pitch, connected speech, fricatives, consonant clusters, the schwa, the stop consonants- stopT&D/B&P/G&K, the flapT, the R, the L, the TH and more... 
My style of teaching is very focused and structured so that you get the most out of every class. You will learn very specific techniques to achieve serious results. This class is for students who are serious about reducing their accent and committed to learning pronunciation the correct way. My students get results quickly because we don't waste any time taking a deep dive into proven techniques that work.
This class can also be modified and changed to adapt to the needs of the student.
